basic_details.job_title: DDAWO Theni Assistant Receptionist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline

age_limit.details: Applicants must not be over 40 years of age.

how_to_apply: Verify that you meet the required educational qualification, community category (Backward Classes - Muslim), visual impairment criteria, and chair weaving experience.
Obtain a copy of the application format or prepare your application as required.
Attach proof of employment office registration, if registered.
Attach certificate proving Backward Classes (Muslim) community status.
Attach identity card for persons with disabilities (UDID Card), Aadhaar card, family food supply card, and 2 recent passport-size photographs.
Submit the filled application along with all required certificates by hand.
Deliver the application to the District Differently Abled Welfare Office, located inside the District Collectorate Campus, Theni.
Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 29 October 2026 by 5:00 PM.
important_instructions: Applications must be submitted by hand directly to the specified office. Applications received after 5:00 PM on 29 October 2026 will not be accepted. Applicants must be completely visually impaired. One year of chair weaving experience is mandatory. The applicant must belong to the Backward Classes (Muslim) category.
